Welcome to Git & GitHub Tutorial!

Git & GitHub Tutorial is a comprehensive, project-based course designed to take you from a complete beginner to a confident, production-ready version control expert.

With 80 structured topics across 8 powerful modules, you’ll gain the exact skills required to manage code professionally, collaborate seamlessly with engineering teams, and contribute to global open-source projects. 


What You’ll Learn

Git Under the Hood: Demystify how Git actually works to truly understand commits, trees, and references.

Advanced Branching & Merging: Master branching strategies (like Git Flow), handle merge conflicts with ease, and keep your history clean.

Seamless GitHub Collaboration: Learn how to manage remote repositories, issues, and project boards like a pro.

Professional Workflows: Write stellar Pull Requests, conduct effective Code Reviews, and work efficiently within team environments.

Advanced Techniques & Troubleshooting: Master rebase, cherry-pick, stash, and the ultimate safety net: reflog.

CI/CD with GitHub Actions: Automate your development workflow with powerful, real-world continuous integration pipelines.

Industry Best Practices: Adopt the exact version control habits, commit message styles, and security strategies used by top developers.


Who Is This For?

Whether you are a student building your first portfolio, a self-taught developer looking to close the skills gap, or an aspiring engineer preparing for your first tech job—this course gives you everything you need to be confident, independent, and highly productive.

Master the developer's most essential tool. Start your journey today!
